page: Microsoft Azure M208ms_v2 is a memory-optimized virtual machine engineered for massive in-memory computing workloads. Running under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor on the x86_64 architecture, this instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8280L processors clocked at 2.7 GHz. It integrates 104 physical cores and 208 virtual CPUs via hyperthreading, backed by 105 MB of shared L3 cache, 2 MB of L2 cache per core, and hardware support for AVX-512 vector extensions. The instance is equipped with 5700 GB of system memory, providing approximately 27.4 GB of RAM per vCPU, alongside 4398 GB of bundled local SSD storage.

Benchmark results demonstrate significant compute and throughput scaling under fully parallelized execution. In multi-threaded evaluation, the system achieved top-tier performance in stress-ng multi-core testing (187,912.86) and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression (596.36 GB/sec). Memory throughput is exceptionally high, delivering 359.81 GB/sec on uncached large-block reads and 149.33 million operations per second on Redis SET benchmarks. Conversely, single-threaded metrics reflect the lower per-core base clock typical of ultra-high-core-count Cascade Lake enterprise silicon, with weak bottom-quartile ratings in Geekbench single-core (1117.0) and single-threaded gzip compression.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the M208ms_v2 offers high hardware consolidation density. While its per-thread latency does not match specialized compute-optimized instances, the extreme memory allocation per core and expansive memory bandwidth mitigate memory bus contention. The inclusion of 4398 GB of local SSD storage facilitates low-latency swap, caching, and scratchpad capabilities without burdening remote network disks.

The Microsoft Azure M208ms_v2 is primarily suited for large-scale in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, massive Redis clusters, in-memory analytics engines, relational database warehousing, and data-intensive batch ETL workloads that demand multi-terabyte working memory sets.
description: Microsoft Azure M208ms_v2 is a dedicated memory-optimized instance featuring 208 vCPUs across 104 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8280L processor operating at 2.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture using Microsoft Hyper-V, the server pairs 5700 GB of RAM with 4398 GB of local SSD storage and no discrete GPUs. The hardware excels in highly parallelized environments, showing top-tier performance in multi-core stress testing, uncached memory bandwidth, and Redis SET throughput reaching 149.33 million operations per second. However, single-core execution speeds in Geekbench and compression tasks place in the bottom quartile, highlighting an operational tradeoff between single-thread latency and aggregate multi-threaded capacity. The M208ms_v2 is engineered for memory-bound enterprise enterprise workloads, including large-scale SAP HANA deployments, massive Redis deployments, real-time in-memory analytics, and high-capacity database systems.
